title: OR11_Response_200_Orders_Customer_BillingAddress

city.description: The city of the billing address of the customer.

civility.description: The civility or title of the customer (e.g., Mr., Mrs., Dr.).

company.description: The company or organization name of the customer billing address.

company2.description: The secondary company or organization name of the customer billing address (e.g., department or subsidiary).

country_iso_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address of the customer.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer.

lastname.description: The last name of the customer.

phone.description: The primary phone number of the customer.

phone_secondary.description: The secondary phone number of the customer.

state.description: The state, province, or region of the billing address of the customer.

street1.description: The primary line of the customer billing address street address (e.g., street number and name).

street2.description: The secondary line of the customer billing address street address (e.g., building, floor, or suite number).

zip_code.description: The postal or zip code of the billing address of the customer.

description: Recipient contact and postal address information for delivery.
